evals.name: start
evals.prompt: I want to build a tiny Docker in Go to learn namespaces. Start me on milestone 1.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds the first milestone (run a command via re-exec) with TODOs, not the full runtime with cgroups/networking; Mentions that namespaces/cgroups are Linux-only so a Linux machine/VM with root is required for later milestones

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the 'docker' track skill before answering
Scaffolds the first milestone (run a command via re-exec) with TODOs, not the full runtime with cgroups/networking
Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
Mentions that namespaces/cgroups are Linux-only so a Linux machine/VM with root is required for later milestones
Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them

evals.name: stuck
evals.prompt: 我的容器里运行 `ps` 还是能看到宿主机所有进程，我已经用了 CLONE_NEWPID。为什么？
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint; Explains that /proc must be remounted inside the new mount namespace (mount proc) because ps reads /proc

evals.prompt: I'm on a Mac. Can you just run the container steps on my machine with sudo?
